## Changes since v0.9.2

### Local clients

- Add `SFL.exe`, a small Go/WebView2 desktop shell in both Windows ZIPs. It resolves Node from `runtime-mode.json` (bundled `runtime\node.exe`, or `SFL_NODE_BINARY`/PATH with a Node 22+ check for `no-node`), starts the backend hidden, opens the one-time connect URL in its own window and stops the backend when the window closes. It falls back to the default browser when the WebView2 runtime is missing or with `--browser`, allows a single instance, sends external links to the default browser, and logs to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ScientificFigureLibrary\logs\desktop.log`. `Start SFL.cmd` and `MCP.cmd` are unchanged; MCP entry points do not go through the shell.
- Add a per-user Windows installer, `ScientificFigureLibrary-<version>-windows-x64-setup.exe` (Inno Setup, no administrator rights), built from the same bundled-Node package. It installs into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ScientificFigureLibrary` with a Start menu entry and an optional desktop shortcut, in Simplified Chinese or English. Upgrades remove the previous program files first, and uninstall leaves libraries, configuration and logs in place. The ZIPs remain for portable use and the `no-node` edition.
- The local web client's gallery page gains clickable facets for research domain, figure type and analysis theme, with counts. They combine with each other and with the query, source and custom-tag filters, and tags on cards filter too. They replace the five fixed suggestion queries.
- Add a "配色" panel under the detail preview, computed entirely on this machine without running template code: the dominant colours of the preview image, an eyedropper with a loupe, colours written in the reference code (hex literals, named colours, and `ggsci`/`RColorBrewer`/viridis/matplotlib palette calls), and copying as HEX, an R vector or a Python list. The macOS client has no facet or colour UI yet.

### External MCP, Skill, and host plugins

- `figure_library_list_catalog` gains a `domain` filter and facet with ten research domains, and returns `familyGroups` and `domains` per entry. An entry can now belong to several figure-type groups, primary first; the 29 group IDs and the `familyGroup` enum are unchanged, and `survival`, `genome`, `enrichment` and `roc` are marked as analysis themes. Search candidates may carry the optional `familyGroups`, `domains` and `templateKind` fields. The standard MCP tool count stays at 62.
- Fix the MCP App staying on "waiting for search results" when a host had already provided the initial result. Besides standard tool-result notifications, the App now reads validated search data from the host's initial compatibility state. Duplicate or late delivery cannot reset a selection or replace a newer search, and this read-only path never calls tools or creates confirmation authority.
- Update the Skill workflow reference and PROTOCOL for the domain filter, multiple groups and the App's initial-result handling.

### Gallery, cache, and library browsing

- Add a bilingual figure and research-field vocabulary: a query that names a figure or field also searches its other names, and the concept's group and domain are matched against what an entry declares. Full-width input is folded, a misspelt figure name is corrected when exactly one vocabulary word is one edit away, and long Chinese phrases contribute two-character slices that count only when at least two match.
- Add a reviewed FigureYa taxonomy (`assets/figureya-taxonomy.json`) that records figure-type groups and research domains for all 319 modules, drafted from each module's plotting calls and checked by hand. No module is unclassified any more, and data-preparation modules are marked as analysis. Open Figure and Local Published entries take domains from their declared tags, `plotFamily` and module ID through a fixed alias table.
- A reviewed group now outranks a family word that only appears inside an identifier, and a FigureYa serial number is no longer read as part of the name (`FigureYa33DCA` is no longer treated as a "3d" variant).
- Preserve exact asset identities, preview confirmation and plan/apply boundaries. SFL does not execute plotting code; automated tests and smoke do not replace manual acceptance on a user's device or external host.

### Branding, packaging, and documentation

- Replace the three unrelated SFL icons with one set (stacked cards forming an F, a density curve and three bars) across plugins, the Skill, the local app, the MCP App, `SFL.exe`, the macOS app, the website and README banners. Editable sources live in `design/brand/` and are not shipped in packages.
- Releases after v0.9.2 add the Windows setup and its SHA-256 sidecar (31 to 33 assets). The Windows CI job builds the desktop shell and installer and runs install, reinstall and uninstall smoke tests. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES records the shell's Go dependencies and Inno Setup.
- Update INSTALL_LOCAL, LOCAL_CLIENT, CI, the user guide and README for the desktop shell, installer, facets and colour panel.

## 相对 v0.9.2 的变化

### 本地客户端

- 两个 Windows ZIP 新增 Go/WebView2 桌面外壳 `SFL.exe`。它按 `runtime-mode.json` 选择 Node（内置 `runtime\node.exe`；`no-node` 版使用 `SFL_NODE_BINARY` 或 PATH，并检查 Node 22+），在后台启动服务，在独立窗口中打开一次性连接地址，关闭窗口时停止服务。缺少 WebView2 运行时或使用 `--browser` 时改用默认浏览器；只允许单实例；外部链接交给默认浏览器；日志写入 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\ScientificFigureLibrary\logs\desktop.log`。`Start SFL.cmd` 与 `MCP.cmd` 不变，MCP 入口不经过外壳。
- 新增按用户安装的 Windows 安装程序 `ScientificFigureLibrary-<version>-windows-x64-setup.exe`（Inno Setup，无需管理员权限），与内置 Node 安装包使用同一份文件。默认安装到 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ScientificFigureLibrary`，提供开始菜单入口和可选桌面快捷方式，界面支持简体中文与英文。升级前先移除旧版程序文件；卸载不删除图库、配置和日志。ZIP 仍用于便携使用和 `no-node` 版。
- 本地网页的图库页新增研究领域、图型与分析主题三组可点击分面，带计数；分面之间、与关键词、来源及自定义标签筛选可以组合，点击卡片上的标签也能筛选。分面取代原先五个固定推荐查询。
- 详情页预览下方新增「配色」面板，完全在本机计算，不运行模板代码：提取预览图的主色、吸管取色（带放大镜）、解析参考代码中写明的颜色（十六进制、颜色名，以及 `ggsci`/`RColorBrewer`/viridis/matplotlib 调色板调用），可复制为 HEX、R 向量或 Python 列表。macOS 客户端暂无分面和配色界面。

### 外部 MCP、Skill 与宿主插件

- `figure_library_list_catalog` 新增 `domain` 过滤和分面（十个研究领域），每个条目返回 `familyGroups` 与 `domains`。一个条目可属于多个图型分组，主分组在前；29 个分组 ID 与 `familyGroup` 枚举不变，`survival`、`genome`、`enrichment`、`roc` 标为分析主题。搜索候选可附带可选的 `familyGroups`、`domains` 与 `templateKind` 字段。标准 MCP 工具数量仍为 62。
- 修复宿主已提供初始结果时，MCP App 仍停留在“等待搜索结果”的问题。除标准结果通知外，App 现在会读取宿主初始兼容状态中经过校验的检索数据；重复或迟到的交付不会重置选择、也不会替换更新的检索。该只读路径不调用工具，也不产生确认凭证。
- 同步更新 Skill 工作流参考与 PROTOCOL，说明领域过滤、多分组及 App 初始结果处理。

### 图库、缓存与本地浏览

- 新增双语图型与研究领域词表：查询中提到的图型或领域会同时搜索它的其他叫法，并将概念对应的分组和领域与条目声明的值匹配。全角输入会被规范化；拼错的图型名在词表中恰有一个编辑距离为 1 的词时自动纠正；较长的中文短语按两字切片匹配，至少命中两片才计分。
- 新增人工复核的 FigureYa 分类（`assets/figureya-taxonomy.json`），为全部 319 个模块记录图型分组和研究领域：先根据各模块的绘图调用起草，再逐条人工核对。现在没有未分类的模块，纯数据准备模块标为分析类。Open Figure 与 Local Published 条目通过固定别名表，从声明的标签、`plotFamily` 和模块 ID 得到研究领域。
- 已复核的分组优先于仅出现在标识符中的图型词；FigureYa 序号不再被当作名称的一部分（`FigureYa33DCA` 不再被视为 “3d” 变体）。
- 保留精确资产身份、预览确认与 plan/apply 边界。SFL 不执行绘图代码；自动化测试与 smoke 不替代用户设备或真实外部宿主上的人工验收。

### 品牌、打包与文档

- 用一套新图标（叠层卡片组成的 F、密度曲线和三根柱形）替换原先互不相关的三套 SFL 图标，覆盖插件、Skill、本地应用、MCP App、`SFL.exe`、macOS 应用、官网与 README 横幅。可编辑源文件位于 `design/brand/`，不随安装包分发。
- v0.9.2 之后的发布新增 Windows 安装程序及其 SHA-256 文件（资产由 31 个增至 33 个）。Windows CI 构建桌面外壳和安装程序，并运行安装、覆盖安装与卸载 smoke。THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES 记录外壳的 Go 依赖与 Inno Setup。
- 同步更新 INSTALL_LOCAL、LOCAL_CLIENT、CI、用户手册与 README，说明桌面外壳、安装程序、分面和配色面板。
